description: React component for an action menu in Mattermost, handling autocomplete suggestions for users, channels, and menu options, and managing selection state.

classes.name: ActionMenu
classes.description: React component class for the action menu with autocomplete functionality.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up providers based on action data source, and default options.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Updates state when new props are received, particularly the selected option.

methods.name: handleSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of an autocomplete option, updates state, and triggers external action.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the autocomplete selector within the post context.
